- agents.md:588,589 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The documented line numbers for the editor-summary and failure-comment steps are incorrect.
  WHY: The docs point to lines like 2136 and 4307, but the actual workflow steps are elsewhere, which misleads maintainers; all reviewers agreed this is documentation drift.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3231-3240 | severity=medium | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The failure body shown after `EDITOR_SUMMARY_POSTED=true` is too generic and does not explicitly name the downstream failure domains documented by `agents.md`.
  WHY: The contract says the message should mention the relevant downstream domains, but the implementation only says the workflow failed and to check details; reviewers disagreed only on phrasing, not on the underlying gap.
- agents.md:538 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The shell parameter expansion example is missing braces around `REVIEW_LEDGER_PATH`.
  WHY: As written, the documented expression is invalid shell syntax if copied literally; this is a singleton finding.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:476-700 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash, deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: The per-PR ledger path default is expressed inconsistently between the scripts.
  WHY: One script uses `${PR_NUMBER:-0}` while the other uses `${PR_NUMBER}`, which still resolves to the same path in practice but creates avoidable inconsistency; reviewers differed on whether this is a latent bug or just style.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1779-1780 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The inline comment referring to the failure-comment step points to the wrong line number.
  WHY: The comment says the failure-comment step is around line 4307, but the actual step is elsewhere, so the note is stale documentation.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1770-1780 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The `EDITOR_SUMMARY_POSTED` signal is written via `$GITHUB_ENV`, which was questioned as a propagation risk in abnormal termination.
  WHY: Reviewers noted the worst case is only a fallback message, and another reviewer explicitly called this not an issue in normal GitHub Actions job flow.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:5155-5185 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The updated test coverage and comments around the extracted verifier scripts were called out as incomplete/possibly confusing.
  WHY: One reviewer said the test comments may confuse maintainers and another said there is no direct test for the per-PR ledger path behavior; both are low-confidence, non-runtime concerns.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1790,3220-3252 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The failure comment when `EDITOR_SUMMARY_POSTED=true` does not name the downstream step domains as documented in `agents.md`.
  WHY: The failure comment body says to check the workflow run for details, but it does not specify the downstream domains (push, conflict resolver, auto-merge config, telemetry) that the documentation says should be named.
- agents.md:588,589 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Line number references for editor-summary and failure-comment steps are incorrect.
  WHY: The documentation points to line 2136 for editor-summary and line 4307 for failure-comment, but the actual workflow lines are around 1790 and 3213.
- agents.md:538 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The shell parameter expansion example is missing braces around `REVIEW_LEDGER_PATH`.
  WHY: The text shows `REVIEW_LEDGER_PATH:-.ai/review_issue_ledger/pr-${PR_NUMBER:-0}.txt` instead of `${REVIEW_LEDGER_PATH:-...}`, which could lead to copy-paste errors.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:478 vs scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh:700 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Different default `PR_NUMBER` fallback between ledger detector and ledger writer.
  WHY: One script uses `${PR_NUMBER:-0}` while the other uses `${PR_NUMBER}`, so local non-CI runs can produce inconsistent per-PR paths.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1790 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `EDITOR_SUMMARY_POSTED` depends on `$GITHUB_ENV`, which may not propagate in abnormal termination.
  WHY: If the job is cancelled or terminated before the failure step runs, the variable might not be available, though the impact is limited to an incorrect failure message.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
